directions.title: Your AI is Lying — RAG Fixes It
directions.audienceProblem: LLMs confidently fabricate facts because they rely on stale training data and fill memory gaps with plausible-sounding fiction.
directions.tensionHook: Your AI just made up a fact. It sounded perfect. It was completely wrong.
directions.promise: Show exactly how RAG grounds every LLM response in real, retrievable evidence so hallucinations disappear.
directions.payoff: The LLM now answers from your actual documents, with source citations you can verify.
directions.visualApproach: Split-screen showing an LLM hallucinating vs RAG retrieving real documents; animated pipeline diagram of chunk→embed→search→generate.
directions.musicMood: curious tension building to confident resolution

directions.title: How RAG Actually Works in 60 Seconds
directions.audienceProblem: Engineers hear 'RAG' everywhere but don't understand the actual data flow from document ingestion to grounded generation.
directions.tensionHook: Everyone says 'just use RAG' but nobody shows you the actual pipeline.
directions.promise: Walk through the complete RAG architecture: chunk, embed, store, retrieve, generate.
directions.payoff: A clear mental model of the two-stage pipeline you can implement today.
directions.visualApproach: Animated end-to-end pipeline showing documents flowing through chunking, embedding, vector DB storage, then query-time retrieval and prompt injection.
risks: More educational than emotionally hooky — engagement depends on visual quality

directions.title: RAG vs Fine-Tuning: Pick the Wrong One and Your AI Hallucinates More
directions.audienceProblem: Teams waste months fine-tuning models for factual accuracy when RAG would have been faster, cheaper, and more accurate.
directions.tensionHook: You fine-tuned your model for weeks. It hallucinates even more now.
directions.promise: Compare the two strategies and show when each one wins.
directions.payoff: RAG for facts, fine-tuning for behavior — and best practice is to combine both.
directions.visualApproach: Side-by-side comparison meters showing cost, freshness, hallucination rate; then merging into a combined architecture.
directions.musicMood: confrontational tech shifting to balanced resolution
risks: Requires careful framing to not oversimplify fine-tuning's valid uses
